title: 第72章 唐逸到底是皇帝什么人！

管家离开后，一个穿着斗篷，将自己笼罩在阴影下的男人，出现在了门前。少女抬头看了男人一眼，道：“主子，你干嘛要答应和那女人合作？还帮她杀了顾城。”“你不是说咱们现在要韬光养晦吗？现在杀了顾城，皇帝都下令彻查了耶。”男人坐在椅子上，院内阳光明媚，然而哪怕在阳光下，他整个人仿佛依旧处于阴影之中，看不清他的面容。“我不是帮她杀，而是时机到了。”“如今北狄和东虞乱边，那大炎的京都就不能平静。”“只有让大炎自顾不暇，我们才有机会复国。”说到这里，男人忽然沉默了。少女眨了眨眼，道：“主子，你又在想那什么小诗仙的事吗？皇帝将他保护得太好，我们还不知道他是谁耶。”男人微微颔首，道：“继续查吧，我总觉得这个人会成为我们最大的敌人。”男人目光变得锐利无比。谁能想到死气沉沉的大炎军队，竟然被一首《满江红》激发了士气。谁又能想到东虞和北狄联手攻炎，竟然被那家伙的挑拨离间给毁了？炎文帝是个会玩的，小诗仙这个名字已经名动天下了，但小诗仙是谁，他倒是藏得贼好。每次都快查到了，结果查的人莫名其妙死了，查小诗仙的人，反过来被查了。这叫什么事！“好的，我一直在查呢。”话落，小姑娘双手叉腰，气鼓鼓道：“那福伯怎么办？他可是咱们组织的大高手，要是查出他是凶手，那他岂不是很危险？”男人摇了摇头，笑道：“放心吧，他的杀人手法，没人能查到。”“再者，就算是查到了，能留下他的人，京都没几个。”“哦。”小女孩乖巧点头。随即将有一点点粗糙的手，伸到男人面前：“给钱，今晚我想要吃肉，我还在长身体呢，你天天让我吃糠咽菜。”“我给你说，要不是我好养，我早就跑了。”男人被噎住，半晌无语。他指着满院子的鸡，没好气道：“这不都是肉吗？抓两只杀了不就是了？”女孩顿时瞪大双眼：“鸡那么可爱，你竟然要吃鸡？”男人：“？？？”合着外面的你就死命吃，家里养的不能动是吧？最终，男人伸手在怀里摸索了下，摸出了一颗指尖大小的金子。女孩笑着伸手过来，他又将手收了回去：“组织经费紧张，什么地方都需要钱，你省着点花。”“知道了，小气鬼！”女孩一把抢过银子。哼，堂堂影宗宗主，反炎的头号反贼影无踪，竟然穷到掐着指头过日子。丢人。……皇宫。御书房中。听了宁川的汇报，炎文帝猛地站了起来。他满脸震惊，声音尖锐得都有些破音了。这小子竟然这么厉害的吗？刚刚上任，就把锦衣卫一二处查几天都没有破的案子，给破了？宁川却是满头冷汗。陛下，你别高兴得太早，你能先听我说完吗？你这么高兴，我怕你等下把我给砍了。“是，唐逸说是破了，他让臣和陛下这样说的。”宁川连冷汗都不敢擦，妈的，老子居然相信唐逸那小混账。现在知道证据和账册的，可就只有那小子，老子什么都不知道啊！“嗯？什么叫唐逸说破了？”炎文帝看向宁川，抓住了其中的信息。宁川连忙拱手道：“陛下，唐逸说杀人凶手是顾城的管家，而朝中那些借国库银子的大臣的真正账册，唐逸也找到了。”“这些，顾城都在他的练字帖上记录下来了。”“唐逸说顾城字帖的数字都是密码，只要解码，真正的账册就能大白于天下。”“至于如何解码，只有他一个人知道……”炎文帝一怔，差点破口大骂。混账东西，你还给朕玩留一手呢？怎么？想要和朕讨价还价吗？不对，那小子不是这样的人，难不成是朕看错了？他看向宁川，道：“他想做什么？想要封赏？”宁川道：“唐逸不是要封赏，唐逸说那些借国库银子的大臣，竟然敢私自假账，这是欺君之罪。”“那就让他们自己解码，自己打自己的脸。”炎文帝眼睛顿时亮了起来。这小子坏得很呐，他是想要等群臣按照假账还钱的时候，再把真账簿给拿出来。而且，还是让那些大臣，自己解码打自己的脸。哼哼，还算懂事，知道给朕出气了。萧棣那臭小子，怎么就学不到半点……哎，罢了，想起就来气。“嗯，朕准了，就按照你们的计划办吧！”炎文帝目光落在宁川身上，满脸笑容道：“去告诉他，他想要做什么尽管去做，朕都给他兜着。”“还有，再有三日就是沈园诗会了，让他好好准备一下。”虽然对唐逸的诗才很有信心，但还是得认真筹备。沈园诗会，那就是朕给他准备的独属于他的盛宴。只能胜，不能败。宁川心里重重松了一口气，拱手道：“是，臣会转告唐逸。”特娘的，唐逸怕不是陛下的私生子吧？唐逸这么胡来他都不管，竟然还这么怂恿？今日换成太子或者其他任何一个皇子，估计会被打死的好吧。而且，陛下竟然这么看重唐逸在诗会的表现……“嗯，你做得不错，朕记得你家长子已经到了入学的年纪了吧？送入宫中读书吧。”听到炎文帝这话，宁川当场脑袋磕得砰砰响：“臣，谢陛下。”进皇宫陪皇子读书，那是天大的恩宠。将来有这份殊荣在，对其仕途也有极大的帮助。无数大臣挤得头破血流，都没有得到的恩赐，他带了唐逸一天，陛下竟然就这样给他了？这么一搞，怎么搞得像是他和唐逸混，而不是唐逸跟着他混了。从皇宫出来，宁川顿感神清气爽，心头的郁结瞬间一扫而光。苏狂啊苏狂，老子忌惮太子不和你计较。但这一次，你踢到铁板了。你就等着付钱裸奔吧！……东宫。太子正在抚琴，此时得到消息，也是惊得站了起来。“唐逸破案了？怎么可能？！”他难以置信，那个废物竟然能破案？开什么玩笑。但宫里传来的消息不会有错，“去，立即让人去查一下怎么回事？”“不，让苏狂来见本宫，本宫要问问他是干什么吃的！”“怎么让唐逸查出真相了？！”

After the housekeeper left, a man wearing a cloak and shrouding himself in shadow appeared in front of the door. The girl looked up at the man and said, "Master, why did you agree to cooperate with that woman and help her kill Gu Cheng?" "Didn't you say that we should hide our capabilities and bide our time now? Now that we have killed Gu Cheng, the emperor has ordered a thorough investigation." The man was sitting on a chair. The sun was shining brightly in the courtyard, but even in the sunshine, his whole body seemed to be in shadow, and his face could not be seen clearly. "I'm not helping her kill, but the time has come." "Now that Beidi and Dongyu are in chaos, the Great Yan Kyoto cannot be calm." "Only by letting Great Yan take care of itself can we have a chance to restore the country." At this point, the man suddenly fell silent. The girl blinked and said, "Master, are you thinking about the little Shixian again? The emperor protected him so well, we still don't know who he is." The man nodded slightly and said, "Continue to investigate, I always feel that this person will become our biggest enemy." The man's eyes became extremely sharp. Who would have thought that the lifeless Dayan army would be inspired by the song "Man Jiang Hong". Who would have thought that Dongyu and Beidi's joint attack on Yan would be ruined by that guy's instigation. Emperor Yanwen was a playful person, and the name Xiao Shixian was already famous all over the world, but he hid who Xiao Shixian was very well. Every time, the investigation was almost completed, but the person who investigated died inexplicably, and the person who investigated Xiao Shixian was in turn investigated. What is this? "Okay, I've been checking
After saying that, the little girl put her hands on her hips and said angrily: "What about Uncle Fu?" He is a top expert in our organization. If he is found to be the murderer, wouldn't he be very dangerous? The man shook his head and said with a smile: "Don't worry, no one can find out his killing methods." "Moreover, even if he is found, there are not many people in Kyoto who can keep him." ""oh. "The little girl nodded obediently. Then she stretched out her slightly rough hands in front of the man: "Give me money. I want to eat meat tonight. I'm still growing. You let me eat bran every day." "I'm telling you, if I weren't easy to take care of, I would have run away a long time ago." The man choked and was speechless for a long time. He pointed at the chickens in the yard and said angrily: "Isn't this all meat?" Just catch two and kill them. The girl's eyes widened immediately: "Chickens are so cute, but you actually want to eat them." "man:". "You will eat whatever is outside. You can't move the ones raised at home, right?" In the end, the man reached out and groped around in his arms, and found a piece of gold the size of a fingertip. The girl smiled and reached out, and he took his hand back again: "The organization's funds are tight, and money is needed everywhere. Save some money." "Got it, cheapskate." "The girl grabbed the money. Humph, the dignified leader of the Shadow Sect and the number one anti-Yan rebel was so poor that he lived on his fingers. It's shameful. ...In the palace. In the imperial study. After hearing Ning Chuan's report, Emperor Yan Wen stood up suddenly. His face was shocked, and his voice was so sharp that it even broke. Is this kid so powerful?
As soon as he took office, he solved a case that had not been solved for several days by Jinyiwei Division 1 and 2. Ning Chuan was covered in cold sweat. Your Majesty, don't be too happy. Can you listen to what I have to say first? You are so happy, I'm afraid you will chop me down later. "Yes, Tang Yi said it was broken. He asked the minister and His Majesty to say so." Ning Chuan didn't even dare to wipe away the cold sweat. Damn it, I actually believed that little bastard Tang Yi. Now the only one who knows the evidence and account books is that boy. I don’t know anything. "Yeah. What do you mean Tang Yi has revealed it." Emperor Yan Wen looked at Ning Chuan and grasped the information. Ning Chuan quickly raised his hands and said: "Your Majesty, Tang Yi said that the murderer was Gu Cheng's housekeeper, and Tang Yi also found the real account books of the ministers who borrowed money from the treasury." "Gu Cheng recorded all of this on his calligraphy practice book. Here it comes." "Tang Yi said that the numbers in Gu Cheng's copybook are all codes. As long as they are decoded, the real account book will be revealed to the world." "As for how to decode it, he is the only one who knows..." Emperor Yanwen was startled and almost cursed. You bastard, you still have something for me to play with. how. Do you want to bargain with me? No, that boy is not such a person. Maybe I got it wrong. He looked at Ning Chuan and said, "What does he want to do? He wants a reward." Ning Chuan said, "Tang Yi didn't want a reward. Tang Yi said that those ministers who borrowed money from the treasury dared to falsify their accounts privately. This is the crime of deceiving the emperor." "Then let them decode it by themselves and slap themselves in the face." Emperor Yanwen's eyes suddenly lit up.
This kid is very bad. He wants to wait until the ministers pay back the money according to the false accounts before taking out the real account books. Moreover, let those ministers decode it and slap themselves in the face. Humph, you are quite sensible and know how to vent your anger on me. That brat Xiao Di, why couldn't he learn even a little bit... Oh, that's all, I get angry just thinking about it. "Well, I'm sure, let's go with your plan." Emperor Yan Wen's eyes fell on Ning Chuan, and he said with a smile on his face: "Go and tell him that he can do whatever he wants, and I will support him." "Also, the Shen Yuan Poetry Festival will be held in three days, so let him prepare well." Although he was very confident in Tang Yi's poetic talent, he still had to prepare carefully. Shen Yuan Poetry Club is his unique feast that I prepared for him. You can only win, not lose. Ning Chuan breathed a sigh of relief, cupped his hands and said, "Yes, I will tell Tang Yi." Damn it, Tang Yi is probably not His Majesty's illegitimate son. He didn't care about Tang Yi's nonsense, but he still encouraged him like this. If it were the prince or any other prince today, he would probably be beaten to death. Moreover, His Majesty actually valued Tang Yi's performance in the poetry meeting so much... "Well, you did a good job. I remember that your eldest son has reached the age of schooling. Send him to the palace to study." Hearing Emperor Yanwen's words, Ning Chuan's head banged on the spot: "Your Majesty, thank you." Entering the palace to study with the prince is a great favor. Having this honor in the future will also be of great help to his career.
Countless ministers were squeezed to death, but none of them received the gift. He took Tang Yi for a day, and His Majesty actually gave it to him like this. By doing this, it made it look like he was hanging out with Tang Yi instead of Tang Yi hanging out with him. After coming out of the palace, Ning Chuan suddenly felt refreshed, and the depression in his heart was instantly swept away. Su Kuang, Su Kuang, I am afraid that the prince will not care about you. But this time, you hit the wall. Just wait and pay to run naked. ...East Palace. The prince was playing the piano, and when he received the news, he stood up in shock. "Tang Yi solved the case. How is it possible?" He couldn't believe that that loser could solve the case. What a joke. But the news from the palace is not wrong, "Go, let someone go find out what's going on immediately." "No, let Su Kuang come to see me. I want to ask what he does for food." "How did Tang Yi find out the truth?"
